verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly references the official meta-framework (SolidStart) via generic SSR/isomorphic/streaming claims (solid-gh-4, solid-gh-11, solid-gh-13) and one community mention that explicitly names 'SolidStart routing' but flags it as 'very slow with no workaround' (solid-comm-15), so its existence is corroborated but its quality for routing/data fetching is called into question. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of SolidStart's routing and data-loading APIs, independent confirmation of solid performance/stability, and broader community validation beyond one critical remark.
